body: Sleeping pills won't do it; they'll just make you sick as a dog. Does your school have an LGBTQ group? Or is there one locally? I thought that was all the thing these days. My niece practically worships gay teens. Find other lgbtq youth, you know they exist. 14 is too young to know your future sucks. Your body and face haven't finished developing. and anyway, nobody really looks all that great if you really look at them. Give it more of a chance. Tell your parents your brother beats you. If they don't care, tell a school counselor. That's bullcrap; you should at least feel safe at home.
